fighter.name: Fighting Style: Archery
fighter.description: You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls you make with ranged weapons.

fighter.name: Fighting Style: Defense
fighter.description: While you are wearing armor, you gain a +1 bonus to AC.

fighter.name: Fighting Style: Dueling
fighter.description: When you are wielding a melee weapon in one hand and no other weapons, you gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls with that weapon.

fighter.name: Fighting Style: Great Weapon Fighting
fighter.description: When you roll a 1 or 2 on a damage die for an attack you make with a melee weapon that you are wielding with two hands, you can reroll the die.

fighter.name: Fighting Style: Protection
fighter.description: When a creature you can see attacks a target other than you within 5 feet of you, you can use your Reaction to impose Disadvantage on the attack roll (requires shield).

fighter.name: Fighting Style: Two-Weapon Fighting
fighter.description: When you engage in two-weapon fighting, you can add your ability modifier to the damage of the second attack.

fighter.name: Fighting Style: Blind Fighting
fighter.description: You have Blindsight with a range of 10 feet.

fighter.name: Fighting Style: Interception
fighter.description: Reaction when a creature within 5 ft hits an ally: reduce damage by 1d10 + your Proficiency Bonus (requires shield or weapon).

fighter.name: Fighting Style: Thrown Weapon Fighting
fighter.description: Draw a thrown weapon as part of the attack and gain +2 bonus to damage rolls with ranged thrown weapon attacks.

paladin.name: Fighting Style: Defense
paladin.description: While you are wearing armor, you gain a +1 bonus to AC.

paladin.name: Fighting Style: Dueling
paladin.description: When you are wielding a melee weapon in one hand and no other weapons, you gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls with that weapon.

paladin.name: Fighting Style: Great Weapon Fighting
paladin.description: When you roll a 1 or 2 on a damage die for an attack you make with a melee weapon that you are wielding with two hands, you can reroll the die.

paladin.name: Fighting Style: Protection
paladin.description: When a creature you can see attacks a target other than you within 5 feet of you, you can use your Reaction to impose Disadvantage on the attack roll (requires shield).

paladin.name: Fighting Style: Blessed Warrior
paladin.description: You learn two Cleric cantrips (CHA spellcasting) and can swap one on level up.

paladin.name: Fighting Style: Blind Fighting
paladin.description: You have Blindsight with a range of 10 feet.

paladin.name: Fighting Style: Interception
paladin.description: Reaction reduces incoming damage to an adjacent ally by 1d10 + Proficiency Bonus.

ranger.name: Fighting Style: Archery
ranger.description: You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls you make with ranged weapons.

ranger.name: Fighting Style: Defense
ranger.description: While you are wearing armor, you gain a +1 bonus to AC.

ranger.name: Fighting Style: Dueling
ranger.description: When you are wielding a melee weapon in one hand and no other weapons, you gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls with that weapon.

ranger.name: Fighting Style: Two-Weapon Fighting
ranger.description: When you engage in two-weapon fighting, you can add your ability modifier to the damage of the second attack.

ranger.name: Fighting Style: Druidic Warrior
ranger.description: You learn two Druid cantrips (WIS spellcasting) and can swap one on level up.

ranger.name: Fighting Style: Blind Fighting
ranger.description: You have Blindsight with a range of 10 feet.

ranger.name: Fighting Style: Thrown Weapon Fighting
ranger.description: Draw a thrown weapon as part of the attack and gain +2 damage with thrown ranged attacks.

pact_boons.name: Pact of the Blade
pact_boons.description: Action creates a magical pact weapon you are proficient with (or bonds an existing magic weapon).

pact_boons.name: Pact of the Chain
pact_boons.description: Learn Find Familiar and optionally summon an Imp, Pseudodragon, Quasit, or Sprite.

pact_boons.name: Pact of the Tome
pact_boons.description: Receive a Book of Shadows granting three cantrips from any class's spell list.

pact_boons.name: Pact of the Talisman
pact_boons.description: Wear an amulet allowing you to add 1d4 to a failed ability check (Proficiency Bonus times per Long Rest).

eldritch_invocations.name: Agonizing Blast
eldritch_invocations.description: Add your Charisma modifier to the damage each Eldritch Blast beam deals on a hit.

eldritch_invocations.name: Devil's Sight
eldritch_invocations.description: See normally in darkness, both magical and nonmagical, to a distance of 120 feet.

eldritch_invocations.name: Eldritch Mind
eldritch_invocations.description: Advantage on Constitution saving throws you make to maintain Concentration on a spell.

eldritch_invocations.name: Fiendish Vigor
eldritch_invocations.description: Cast False Life on yourself at will as a 1st-level spell without expending a spell slot.

eldritch_invocations.name: Armor of Shadows
eldritch_invocations.description: Cast Mage Armor on yourself at will without expending a spell slot.

eldritch_invocations.name: Mask of Many Faces
eldritch_invocations.description: Cast Disguise Self at will without expending a spell slot.

eldritch_invocations.name: Repelling Blast
eldritch_invocations.description: Push hit creatures up to 10 feet straight away with Eldritch Blast.

eldritch_invocations.name: Grasp of Hadar
eldritch_invocations.description: Once per turn when hitting with Eldritch Blast, pull the target up to 10 feet closer.

eldritch_invocations.name: Beguiling Influence
eldritch_invocations.description: Gain proficiency in the Deception and Persuasion skills.

eldritch_invocations.name: Book of Ancient Secrets
eldritch_invocations.description: Inscribe and cast ritual spells from any class in your Book of Shadows.

eldritch_invocations.name: Improved Pact Weapon
eldritch_invocations.description: Your pact weapon counts as a +1 magic weapon and arcane spellcasting focus, and can form ranged bows/crossbows.

eldritch_invocations.name: Voice of the Chain Master
eldritch_invocations.description: Communicate telepathically and perceive through your familiar's senses across any distance on the same plane.

eldritch_invocations.name: Thirsting Blade
eldritch_invocations.description: Attack twice, rather than once, whenever you take the Attack action with your pact weapon.

eldritch_invocations.name: Eldritch Smite
eldritch_invocations.description: Once per turn on hit with your pact weapon, expend a Pact slot to deal +1d8 (+1d8 per slot level) Force damage and knock Prone.

eldritch_invocations.name: One with Shadows
eldritch_invocations.description: Turn Invisible in dim light or darkness until you move or act.

eldritch_invocations.name: Sculptor of Flesh
eldritch_invocations.description: Cast Polymorph once per Long Rest using a Warlock spell slot.

eldritch_invocations.name: Ghostly Gaze
eldritch_invocations.description: Bonus Action sees through solid objects within 30 ft for 1 minute (1/Short Rest).

eldritch_invocations.name: Lifedrinker
eldritch_invocations.description: Deal extra Necrotic damage equal to your Charisma modifier on hits with your pact weapon.

eldritch_invocations.name: Shroud of Shadow
eldritch_invocations.description: Cast Invisibility at will without expending a spell slot.

metamagic.name: Metamagic: Quickened Spell
metamagic.description: Spend 2 Sorcery Points to change a casting time of 1 Action to 1 Bonus Action.

metamagic.name: Metamagic: Twinned Spell
metamagic.description: Spend Sorcery Points equal to a single-target spell's level (1 for cantrips) to target a second creature.

metamagic.name: Metamagic: Subtle Spell
metamagic.description: Spend 1 Sorcery Point to cast a spell without any Somatic or Verbal components.

metamagic.name: Metamagic: Careful Spell
metamagic.description: Spend 1 Sorcery Point to let up to CHA modifier creatures automatically succeed on a spell's save.

metamagic.name: Metamagic: Empowered Spell
metamagic.description: Spend 1 Sorcery Point to reroll up to CHA modifier damage dice of a spell.

metamagic.name: Metamagic: Heightened Spell
metamagic.description: Spend 3 Sorcery Points to impose Disadvantage on one target's first save against your spell.

metamagic.name: Metamagic: Distant Spell
metamagic.description: Spend 1 Sorcery Point to double a spell's range (or turn Touch into 30 ft).

metamagic.name: Metamagic: Extended Spell
metamagic.description: Spend 1 Sorcery Point to double a spell's duration (up to 24 hours).

maneuvers.name: Maneuver: Precision Attack
maneuvers.description: Expend a Superiority Die to add it to a weapon attack roll.

maneuvers.name: Maneuver: Trip Attack
maneuvers.description: Add Superiority Die to damage and force a Large or smaller target to make a STR save or fall Prone.

maneuvers.name: Maneuver: Menacing Attack
maneuvers.description: Add Superiority Die to damage and Frighten the target on a failed WIS save until end of your next turn.

maneuvers.name: Maneuver: Riposte
maneuvers.description: Reaction after a melee attack misses you: make one melee attack adding Superiority Die to damage.

maneuvers.name: Maneuver: Disarming Attack
maneuvers.description: Add Superiority Die to damage and force a STR save or drop one held item.

maneuvers.name: Maneuver: Pushing Attack
maneuvers.description: Add Superiority Die to damage and push a Large or smaller target up to 15 ft on a failed STR save.

maneuvers.name: Maneuver: Commander's Strike
maneuvers.description: Forgo one attack and Bonus Action to grant an ally a Reaction weapon attack adding Superiority Die to damage.

maneuvers.name: Maneuver: Bait and Switch
maneuvers.description: Swap places with an adjacent willing creature within 5 ft, adding Superiority Die to AC until start of next turn.

maneuvers.name: Maneuver: Tactical Assessment
maneuvers.description: Add Superiority Die to an Investigation, History, or Insight check.

artificer_infusions.name: Infusion: Enhanced Defense
artificer_infusions.description: Armor or shield grants +1 bonus to AC (+2 at Artificer level 10).

artificer_infusions.name: Infusion: Enhanced Weapon
artificer_infusions.description: Simple or martial weapon becomes a +1 magic weapon (+2 at Artificer level 10).

artificer_infusions.name: Infusion: Repeating Shot
artificer_infusions.description: +1 magic ranged weapon that ignores Loading and automatically creates ammunition.

artificer_infusions.name: Infusion: Mind Sharpener
artificer_infusions.description: Armor/robes let the wearer use a Reaction to automatically succeed on a failed Concentration save (4 charges).

artificer_infusions.name: Infusion: Bag of Holding
artificer_infusions.description: Replicate a magical Bag of Holding.

artificer_infusions.name: Infusion: Homunculus Servant
artificer_infusions.description: Animate a Tiny mechanical Homunculus Servant.

artificer_infusions.name: Infusion: Radiant Weapon
artificer_infusions.description: +1 magic weapon shedding light with 4 charges to Blind melee attackers as a Reaction.

artificer_infusions.name: Infusion: Winged Boots
artificer_infusions.description: Replicate Winged Boots (Fly Speed equal to walking speed).

3.name: Hunter's Prey: Colossus Slayer
3.description: Once per turn, deal +1d8 weapon damage to a target below its HP maximum.

3.name: Hunter's Prey: Giant Killer
3.description: Reaction makes a weapon attack against an adjacent Large or larger creature that attacks you.

3.name: Hunter's Prey: Horde Breaker
3.description: Once per turn, make an extra weapon attack against a second creature within 5 ft of your original target.

7.name: Defensive Tactics: Multiattack Defense
7.description: When a creature hits you, gain +4 AC against all subsequent attacks made by that creature this turn.

7.name: Defensive Tactics: Escape the Horde
7.description: Opportunity Attacks against you are made with Disadvantage.

7.name: Defensive Tactics: Steel Will
7.description: You have Advantage on saving throws against being Frightened.

11.name: Multiattack: Volley
11.description: Action makes a ranged attack against any number of creatures within 10 ft of a point you can see.

11.name: Multiattack: Whirlwind Attack
11.description: Action makes a melee attack against any number of creatures within 5 ft of you.

15.name: Superior Hunter's Defense: Uncanny Dodge
15.description: Reaction halves an attacker's damage against you.

15.name: Superior Hunter's Defense: Evasion
15.description: Take 0 damage on successful DEX saves and half on failures.

15.name: Superior Hunter's Defense: Stand Against the Tide
15.description: Reaction forces a creature missing you with a melee attack to repeat it against another nearby creature.
